**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Queue unpaused updates on the writer lock first**

When two non-paused disk updates are submitted while generation holds `model_update_lock.reader_lock`, this outer operation lock keeps the second update from queuing on `model_update_lock.writer_lock`. After the first update releases the writer lock, waiting generation readers can acquire it before the second update increments `_waiting_writers`, so requests accepted after the second update was requested can run on the intermediate weights; before this change, both updates queued as writers and RWLock's writer preference blocked those readers. Queue the unpaused path on the writer lock before taking the operation lock.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Apply weight version when draining cancellations**

When a disk weight update with `weight_version` is cancelled after dispatch, this drain lets `_wait_for_model_update_from_disk` finish and update `model_path`, but the re-raise skips the existing `success && obj.weight_version` block below. The scheduler has loaded the new weights, yet `/model_info` and generation metadata continue to expose the old `weight_version`; capture the drained result and apply the version update before propagating cancellation.

body: Fixed in 901903d6ca. Unpaused updates now acquire `model_update_lock.writer_lock` before waiting for `model_update_operation_lock`, so every requested update increments the RWLock's queued-writer state before later generation readers can enter. The new `test_unpaused_updates_preserve_writer_preference` holds an active reader, queues two updates, then proves the second update dispatches before a later reader acquires the lock.

body: Fixed in 901903d6ca. Successful result finalization now remains inside operation ownership: after a cancelled caller's scheduler task is drained, `weight_version` is published before cancellation is re-raised. The drain also survives repeated cancellation so the untagged response cannot be orphaned. Covered by `test_cancelled_successful_update_still_publishes_weight_version` and `test_repeated_cancellation_cannot_interrupt_response_drain`.
